source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 16 (PDF 61-84), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 16 (Electrostatics / Static Electricity) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Electrostatics deals with the phenomena arising from:
(Electrostatics (sakin barqiyat) kin cheezon se paida hone wale mazahir ka mutala hai?)
blocks.explanation: Electrostatics sakin (stationary) charges se paida hone wale mazahir ka naam hai (Introduction).

book_ref.quote: Electrostatics or static electricity refers to the phenomena arising from the stationary electric charges

blocks.prompt:
2 The direction of the electrostatic force between two charges depends on:
(Do charges ke darmiyan electrostatic force ki simt kis cheez par munhasir hai?)
blocks.explanation: Coulomb force ki simt is par munhasir hai ke charges positive hain ya negative (Introduction).

book_ref.quote: The direction of this force depends on the nature of charges whether positive or negative

blocks.prompt:
3 Electric potential difference between two points is the:
(Do points ke darmiyan electric potential difference kya hai?)

options.text: fi unit charge kaam jo charge ko do points ke darmiyan le jane mein hota hai
kisi point par fi unit charge force

blocks.explanation: Potential difference V = W_AB/q₀: do points ke darmiyan charge ko le jane mein fi unit charge kaam (16.1).

book_ref.quote: The electric potential difference is the work done per unit charge in moving a charge between two points

blocks.prompt:
4 One volt is equal to:
(Aik volt kis ke barabar hai?)

book_ref.quote: The SI unit is the volt, where

blocks.prompt:
5 In E = −ΔV/Δd, the negative sign shows that the electric field points:
(E = −ΔV/Δd mein negative nishan kya batata hai ke electric field kis taraf hai?)

options.text: kam potential se zyada potential ki taraf
zyada potential se kam potential ki taraf

blocks.explanation: Minus nishan batata hai ke field zyada potential se kam potential ki taraf hoti hai (16.1).

book_ref.quote: Where the negative sign indicates that the field points from higher to lower potential

blocks.prompt:
6 The electric field intensity at a point is equal to the negative of:
(Kisi point par electric field intensity kis cheez ke negative ke barabar hai?)

options.text: waqt ke saath potential ki tabdeeli ki sharah
faasle ke saath potential ki tabdeeli ki sharah
potential aur faasle ka hasil zarb

blocks.explanation: E = −ΔV/Δd: field faasle ke saath potential ki tabdeeli ki sharah (rate) ka negative hai (16.1).

book_ref.quote: the electric field represents the rate of change of potential with distance

blocks.prompt:
7 On moving along the direction of a uniform electric field, the electric potential:
(Uniform electric field ki simt mein chalne par electric potential:)

options.text: pehle barhta phir kam hota hai

blocks.explanation: ΔV = −E Δd: field ki simt mein potential kam hota hai (16.1).

book_ref.quote: a stronger electric field causes a more rapid decrease in potential

blocks.prompt:
8 For the same distance, a stronger uniform electric field gives:
(Utne hi faasle par zyada taqatwar uniform electric field kya deti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Uniform field mein V = Ed, is liye taqatwar field se potential zyada tezi se girta hai (16.1).

book_ref.quote: a stronger electric field causes a more rapid decrease in potential

blocks.prompt:
9 A 12 V battery is connected across two parallel plates 0.4 cm apart. The electric field between the plates is:
(12 V ki battery do parallel plates se jori gayi hai jo 0.4 cm door hain. Plates ke darmiyan electric field kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: In the case of a uniform electric field, this relation simplifies to:

blocks.prompt:
10 Two points 2 mm apart lie along a uniform field of 5000 N C⁻¹. The potential difference between them is:
(Do points 5000 N C⁻¹ ki uniform field mein 2 mm door hain. Un ke darmiyan potential difference kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: Showing that the potential difference between two points is directly proportional to the electric field strength

blocks.prompt:
11 Work of 3 × 10⁻⁴ J is done in moving a charge of 6 μC between two points. The potential difference between them is:
(6 μC charge ko do points ke darmiyan le jane mein 3 × 10⁻⁴ J kaam hota hai. Potential difference kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: The electric potential difference is the work done per unit charge in moving a charge between two points

blocks.prompt:
12 In practice, the absolute value of electric potential at a point is measured with respect to:
(Amli tor par kisi point ka absolute potential kis ke mutabiq naapa jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Agarche infinity ko zero potential mana jata hai, amli tor par Earth (zameen) ko zero potential mana jata hai (16.1).

book_ref.quote: the Earth is assumed to be at zero potential practically

blocks.prompt:
13 The reference point of zero electric potential for a point charge is usually taken:
(Point charge ke liye zero potential ka hawala (reference) point aam tor par kahan liya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Zero potential ka reference aam tor par infinity (la-mehdood faasle) par liya jata hai (16.2).

book_ref.quote: we must have a reference to which we assign zero electric potential. This point is usually taken at infinity

blocks.prompt:
14 Electric potential at a point is the work done in bringing a unit positive charge:
(Kisi point par electric potential, unit positive charge ko kahan se us point tak lane ka kaam hai?)

options.text: us point se infinity tak, acceleration ke saath
infinity se us point tak, equilibrium mein
Earth se us point tak, acceleration ke saath

blocks.explanation: Potential = unit positive charge ko infinity se us point tak equilibrium mein lane ka kaam (16.2).

book_ref.quote: The electric potential at any point in an electric field is equal to work done in bringing a unit positive charge from infinity

blocks.prompt:
15 Electric potential is a scalar quantity because:
(Electric potential scalar quantity kyun hai?)

options.text: work aur charge dono scalars hain

blocks.explanation: V = W/q₀ aur W aur q₀ dono scalars hain (16.2).

book_ref.quote: Both potential and potential differences are scalar quantities because both W and q

blocks.prompt:
16 ΔV = −E Δr cannot be used directly over a large distance from a point charge because:
(Point charge se bare faasle par ΔV = −E Δr seedha kyun istemal nahi ho sakta?)

options.text: charge ke qareeb E sifar hai
E har jagah aik jaisi hai
E faasle ke murabba (square) ke ulat badalti hai

blocks.explanation: Point charge ke gird E ∝ 1/r², is liye E sabit nahi; bunyadi usool se hal kiya jata hai (16.2).

book_ref.quote: However in this case E varies inversely as square of distance from the point charge

blocks.prompt:
17 In deriving the potential of a point charge, for points A and B very close together, r² is replaced by:
(Point charge ka potential derive karte waqt, bohat qareeb points A aur B ke liye r² ki jagah kya likha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Arithmetic mean ≈ geometric mean lene se r² = r_A r_B (Eq. 16.11).

book_ref.quote: we can take the arithmetic mean to be equal to geometric mean

blocks.prompt:
18 The absolute potential at distance r from a point charge q is:
(Point charge q se r faasle par absolute potential kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Infinity par V_B = 0 rakhne se V = (1/4πε₀)(q/r) (Eq. 16.16-16.17).

book_ref.quote: To calculate absolute potential or potential at A, point B is assumed to be infinity point

blocks.prompt:
19 If the distance from a point charge is doubled, the electric potential becomes:
(Point charge se faasla dugna karne par electric potential kitna ho jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: V ∝ 1/r (Eq. 16.17), is liye r dugna karne se V aadha.

book_ref.quote: The general expression for electric potential

blocks.prompt:
20 The electric potential at a point 0.9 m from a charge of 4.0 × 10⁻⁸ C is (1/4πε₀ = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²):
(4.0 × 10⁻⁸ C charge se 0.9 m door point par electric potential kitna hai (1/4πε₀ = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²)?)

book_ref.quote: Find the electric potential at a point 1.2 m from a charge

blocks.prompt:
21 The potential at 30 cm from a charge of −3 nC is (1/4πε₀ = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²):
(−3 nC charge se 30 cm door potential kitna hai (1/4πε₀ = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²)?)
blocks.explanation: V = (9 × 10⁹)(−3 × 10⁻⁹)/0.30 = −90 V; negative charge ka potential negative hota hai (16.2).

book_ref.quote: The electric potential will be negative if the charge q is negative

blocks.prompt:
22 The total electric potential at a point due to several charges is:
(Kayi charges ki wajah se kisi point par kul electric potential kya hai?)

options.text: alag alag potentials ka vector jama
alag alag potentials ka algebraic jama
alag alag potentials ka hasil zarb

blocks.explanation: Potential scalar hai; kul potential alag alag potentials ka algebraic jama hai (16.2).

book_ref.quote: the total electric potential is the algebraic sum of the individual potentials created by all the charges

blocks.prompt:
23 Charges of +2 nC and +3 nC are each 0.3 m from a point P. The total potential at P is (1/4πε₀ = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²):
(+2 nC aur +3 nC charges dono point P se 0.3 m door hain. P par kul potential kitna hai (1/4πε₀ = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²)?)

book_ref.quote: the total electric potential is the algebraic sum of the individual potentials created by all the charges

blocks.prompt:
24 Charges +9 μC and −3 μC are 40 cm apart. The zero-potential point between them is at a distance from the +9 μC charge of:
(+9 μC aur −3 μC charges 40 cm door hain. Un ke darmiyan zero potential wala point +9 μC se kitna door hai?)
blocks.explanation: 9/x = 3/(40 − x) se 360 − 9x = 3x, x = 30 cm (chhote negative charge ke qareeb, 16.2).

book_ref.quote: so there will be two zero potential points. Both the points should be closer to the smaller negative charge

blocks.prompt:
25 For the same charges (+9 μC and −3 μC, 40 cm apart), the zero-potential point outside them lies beyond the negative charge at:
(Unhi charges (+9 μC aur −3 μC, 40 cm door) ke liye bahar wala zero potential point negative charge se aage kitna door hai?)
blocks.explanation: 9/(40 + y) = 3/y se 9y = 120 + 3y, y = 20 cm, −3 μC charge se aage (16.2).

book_ref.quote: so there will be two zero potential points. Both the points should be closer to the smaller negative charge

blocks.prompt:
26 When the first charge Q is brought from infinity to point A where there is no electric field, the work done is:
(Jab pehla charge Q infinity se point A par laya jata hai jahan koi electric field nahi, to kaam kitna hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: A par koi field nahi, is liye Q ko koi rukawat nahi aur W_A = 0 (Eq. 16.19).

book_ref.quote: Therefore, the work done to bring Q to point A is zero.

blocks.prompt:
27 The electric potential energy of two point charges Q and q separated by r is:
(r faasle par do point charges Q aur q ki electric potential energy kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: the work done in placing these two charges at points A and B is stored as electric potential energy

blocks.prompt:
28 Charges of 6 μC and 3 μC are 9.0 cm apart. Their electric potential energy is (1/4πε₀ = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²):
(6 μC aur 3 μC charges 9.0 cm door hain. Un ki electric potential energy kitni hai (1/4πε₀ = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²)?)

book_ref.quote: Two point charges are separated by a distance of 4.0 cm.

blocks.prompt:
29 Charges of +4 μC and −2 μC are 0.2 m apart. Their electric potential energy is (1/4πε₀ = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²):
(+4 μC aur −2 μC charges 0.2 m door hain. Un ki electric potential energy kitni hai (1/4πε₀ = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²)?)

book_ref.quote: The concept of electric potential directly leads to the expression for electric potential energy of two point charges

blocks.prompt:
30 If the separation of two point charges is made three times, their electric potential energy becomes:
(Agar do point charges ka darmiyani faasla teen guna kar diya jaye to un ki potential energy:)
blocks.explanation: E_p ∝ 1/r (Eq. 16.24), is liye r teen guna karne se E_p aik tihaai.

book_ref.quote: Once the charge Q has been placed at point A, an electric potential V is created by it at point B.

blocks.prompt:
31 A charge of 2 μC is brought from infinity to a point where another charge has created a potential of 300 V. The work done is:
(2 μC charge ko infinity se aise point par laya jata hai jahan doosre charge ne 300 V potential banaya hai. Kaam kitna hua?)

book_ref.quote: work has to be done in moving it against the electric filed

blocks.prompt:
32 A positive charge free to move in an electric field accelerates:
(Electric field mein azad positive charge kis taraf accelerate karta hai?)

options.text: kam se zyada potential ki taraf
zyada se kam potential ki taraf

blocks.explanation: Azad positive charge hamesha zyada se kam potential ki taraf accelerate karta hai (16.3).

book_ref.quote: it will always accelerate from a point of higher potential to a point of lower potential

blocks.prompt:
33 An electron released in an electric field moves:
(Electric field mein chhora gaya electron kis taraf harkat karta hai?)

options.text: zyada se kam potential ki taraf
kam se zyada potential ki taraf

blocks.explanation: Azad negative charge kam se zyada potential ki taraf harkat karta hai (16.3).

book_ref.quote: A negative charge allowed to move freely in an electric field moves from a point of lower potential to a point of higher potential.

blocks.prompt:
34 When a free charge q₀ moves through a potential difference ΔV, the gain in its kinetic energy equals:
(Jab azad charge q₀ potential difference ΔV se guzarta hai to us ki kinetic energy mein izafa kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Potential energy ki kami ΔU = q₀ΔV kinetic energy ban jati hai: ½mv² = q₀ΔV (Eq. 16.18).

book_ref.quote: This decrease in potential energy of the charge will appear as its kinetic energy.

blocks.prompt:
35 A particle of mass 2.5 × 10⁻⁶ kg carrying 5 μC starts from rest and moves through a potential difference of 100 V. Its final speed is:
(2.5 × 10⁻⁶ kg mass aur 5 μC charge wala zarra sukoon se 100 V potential difference se guzarta hai. Us ki aakhri raftaar kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: the body will reach the point at lower potential energy with velocity v

blocks.prompt:
36 Electron-volt (eV) is a unit of:
(Electron-volt (eV) kis cheez ki unit hai?)
blocks.explanation: eV energy ki unit hai jo atomic physics mein istemal hoti hai (16.3).

book_ref.quote: In atomic physics, we use one such unit of energy known as electron-volt (eV).

blocks.prompt:
37 One electron-volt is equal to:
(Aik electron-volt kis ke barabar hai?)
blocks.explanation: 1 eV = electron ka charge × 1 volt = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J (16.3).

book_ref.quote: It is the energy required by an electron which has been accelerated through a potential difference of 1 volt.

blocks.prompt:
38 An electron accelerated from rest through 200 V gains kinetic energy of:
(Sukoon se 200 V ke zariye accelerate hone wala electron kitni kinetic energy hasil karta hai?)

book_ref.quote: It is the energy required by an electron which has been accelerated through a potential difference of 1 volt.

blocks.prompt:
39 An energy of 4.8 × 10⁻¹⁷ J expressed in electron-volts is:
(4.8 × 10⁻¹⁷ J energy electron-volt mein kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: The equation (16.18) suggests that the energy can also be expressed as the product of potential difference and charge.

blocks.prompt:
40 The two types of capacitors discussed in this chapter are:
(Is chapter mein capacitors ki kaun si do aqsaam par baat ki gayi hai?)

options.text: isolated spherical conductors aur parallel plate capacitors

blocks.explanation: 16.4 mein (i) isolated spherical conductors aur (ii) parallel plate capacitors bayan hue hain.

book_ref.quote: We will discuss here two types of such devices.

blocks.prompt:
41 An isolated spherical conductor is one that is:
(Isolated spherical conductor kise kehte hain?)

options.text: doosre conductors ya asar se door

blocks.explanation: Jo kurra (sphere) doosre conductors ya asar se door ho woh isolated spherical conductor hai (16.4).

book_ref.quote: A spherical conductor placed in space such that it is far from other conductors or influence is known as an isolated spherical conductor

blocks.prompt:
42 The capacitance of an isolated spherical conductor is the:
(Isolated spherical conductor ki capacitance kya hai?)

options.text: surface ke fi unit potential par jama charge

blocks.explanation: C = Q/V: surface ke fi unit potential par jama charge (Eq. 16.25).

book_ref.quote: defined as the electric charge stored on the sphere per unit electric potential at its surface

blocks.prompt:
43 The capacitance of an isolated sphere of radius R in vacuum is:
(Vacuum mein R radius wale isolated sphere ki capacitance kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: V = (1/4πε₀)(Q/R) ko C = Q/V mein rakhne se C = 4πε₀R (Eq. 16.26).

book_ref.quote: The electric potential V at the surface of the sphere of radius R is given by

blocks.prompt:
44 The capacitance of an isolated sphere of radius 9 cm is (1/4πε₀ = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²):
(9 cm radius wale isolated sphere ki capacitance kitni hai (1/4πε₀ = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²)?)

book_ref.quote: the capacitance of a spherical conductor is independent of the charge or potential

blocks.prompt:
45 A sphere of capacitance 10 pF is raised to a surface potential of 3000 V. The charge on it is:
(10 pF capacitance wale sphere ka surface potential 3000 V hai. Us par charge kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: This means larger spheres store more charge at the same surface potential.

blocks.prompt:
46 If the radius of an isolated sphere is doubled, its capacitance becomes:
(Isolated sphere ka radius dugna karne par us ki capacitance:)
blocks.explanation: C = 4πε₀R, yani C ∝ R; R dugna to C dugna (16.4).

book_ref.quote: The capacitance increases with increase in radius of the sphere.

blocks.prompt:
47 An isolated sphere is placed in a medium of dielectric constant 3. Its capacitance compared with that in vacuum is:
(Isolated sphere ko 3 dielectric constant wale medium mein rakha jata hai. Vacuum ke muqable mein us ki capacitance:)
blocks.explanation: C = 4πε₀εᵣR (Eq. 16.27), is liye εᵣ = 3 se teen guna.

book_ref.quote: However, the capacitance of a spherical conductor in a medium of dielectric constant

blocks.prompt:
48 On a charged isolated spherical conductor the charge resides:
(Charged isolated spherical conductor par charge kahan hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Conductor par charge bairooni surface par hota hai (16.4, Fig. 16.5 ki Book correction).

book_ref.quote: On a conductor the charge lies on the outer surface

blocks.prompt:
49 For a spherical conductor, one farad is the capacitance of a sphere which stores:
(Spherical conductor ke liye aik farad us sphere ki capacitance hai jo:)

options.text: 1 kV potential par 1 C store kare
1 V potential par 1 C store kare

blocks.explanation: 1 farad = 1 coulomb/1 volt (16.4).

book_ref.quote: 1 farad is the capacitance of a sphere that stores 1 coulomb of charge when its electric potential is 1 volt

blocks.prompt:
50 A parallel plate capacitor consists of two conductors separated by:
(Parallel plate capacitor do conductors par mushtamil hai jo kis cheez se juda hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Dono plates vacuum, hawa ya kisi insulator (dielectric) se juda hoti hain (16.5).

book_ref.quote: A parallel plate, capacitor consists of two conductors placed near one another separated by vacuum, air or any other insulator

blocks.prompt:
51 When a capacitor is connected to a battery, the two plates acquire:
(Capacitor ko battery se jorne par dono plates par kya charge aata hai?)

options.text: aik hi nishan ke ghair barabar charges

blocks.explanation: Positive terminal wali plate par +Q aur doosri par −Q aata hai (16.5).

book_ref.quote: the battery places a charge +Q on the plate connected with its positive terminal

blocks.prompt:
52 Capacitance is a measure of the ability of a capacitor to:
(Capacitance capacitor ki kis salahiyat ka paimana hai?)
blocks.explanation: C capacitor ki charge store karne ki salahiyat ka paimana hai (16.5).

book_ref.quote: It is a measure of the ability of capacitor to store charge.

blocks.prompt:
53 The capacitance of a parallel plate capacitor does NOT depend on:
(Parallel plate capacitor ki capacitance kis cheez par munhasir NAHI?)
blocks.explanation: C plates ki geometry aur medium par munhasir hai (16.5, Eq. 16.33), Q par nahi.

book_ref.quote: it depends upon the geometry of the plates and the medium between them

blocks.prompt:
54 The SI unit of capacitance, the farad, is equal to:
(Capacitance ki SI unit farad kis ke barabar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Capacitance ki SI unit coulomb fi volt hai, jise farad kehte hain (16.5).

book_ref.quote: The SI unit of capacitance is coulomb per volt

blocks.prompt:
55 The unit farad is named after:
(Farad unit kis ke naam par rakhi gayi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Farad English scientist Michael Faraday ke naam par hai (16.5).

book_ref.quote: after the famous English scientist Michael Faraday

blocks.prompt:
56 A 20 μF capacitor is connected to a 9 V battery. The charge on each plate is:
(20 μF capacitor 9 V battery se jora gaya hai. Har plate par charge kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: the amount of charge on one plate necessary to raise the potential of that plate by one volt with respect to the other

blocks.prompt:
57 The separation d of a parallel plate capacitor is kept small so that the field between the plates is:
(Parallel plate capacitor mein faasla d chhota rakha jata hai taake plates ke darmiyan field:)

options.text: uniform aur plates ke darmiyan mehdood

blocks.explanation: Chhota d rakhne se E yaksaan (uniform) aur zyada tar plates ke darmiyan rehti hai (16.5).

book_ref.quote: The distance d is small so that the electric field E between the plates is uniform

blocks.prompt:
58 The electric intensity between the plates of a parallel plate capacitor in vacuum is:
(Vacuum mein parallel plate capacitor ki plates ke darmiyan electric intensity kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gauss's law se E = σ/ε₀ = Q/Aε₀ (Eq. 16.31).

book_ref.quote: As electric intensity between parallel plate capacitor (Gauss's law) is:

blocks.prompt:
59 The capacitance of a parallel plate capacitor with vacuum between its plates is:
(Plates ke darmiyan vacuum wale parallel plate capacitor ki capacitance kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: C_vac = Q/V = Aε₀/d (Eq. 16.32).

book_ref.quote: Let initially the medium between the plates be air or vacuum.

blocks.prompt:
60 A parallel plate capacitor has plates of area 0.02 m² separated by 1 mm of air. Its capacitance is (take ε₀ = 8.85 × 10⁻¹² C² N⁻¹ m⁻²):
(Parallel plate capacitor ki plates ka area 0.02 m² aur darmiyan 1 mm hawa hai. Capacitance kitni hai (ε₀ = 8.85 × 10⁻¹² C² N⁻¹ m⁻² lein)?)

book_ref.quote: As electric intensity between parallel plate capacitor (Gauss's law) is:

blocks.prompt:
61 The same capacitor (0.02 m², 1 mm) is filled with a dielectric of εᵣ = 4. Its capacitance becomes (take ε₀ = 8.85 × 10⁻¹² C² N⁻¹ m⁻²):
(Wohi capacitor (0.02 m², 1 mm) εᵣ = 4 wale dielectric se bhar diya jaye to capacitance (ε₀ = 8.85 × 10⁻¹² C² N⁻¹ m⁻² lein):)

book_ref.quote: the capacitance of capacitor is enhanced by the factor

blocks.prompt:
62 If the separation between the plates of a parallel plate capacitor is halved, its capacitance:
(Parallel plate capacitor ki plates ka faasla aadha karne par capacitance:)
blocks.explanation: C = Aε₀/d, yani C ∝ 1/d; d aadha to C dugni (Eq. 16.32).

book_ref.quote: Let initially the medium between the plates be air or vacuum.

blocks.prompt:
63 In the voltmeter experiment of Fig. 16.7, the deflection of the voltmeter connected across the capacitor plates measures the:
(Fig. 16.7 ke voltmeter tajrube mein capacitor plates se jure voltmeter ki deflection kis cheez ka paimana hai?)
blocks.explanation: Meter ki deflection plates ke darmiyan potential difference ka paimana hai (16.5, Fig. 16.7).

book_ref.quote: When a dielectric material is inserted between the plates, reading drops indicating a decrease in the potential difference between the plates

blocks.prompt:
64 On inserting a dielectric into an isolated charged capacitor, which quantity remains constant?
(Isolated charged capacitor mein dielectric dalne par kaun si quantity sabit rehti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Q sabit rehta hai jab ke V kam hota hai, is liye C = Q/V barhta hai (16.5).

book_ref.quote: since V decreases while Q remains constant, the value of C increases

blocks.prompt:
65 A capacitor has capacitance 20 pF with vacuum and 90 pF with a dielectric between its plates. The dielectric constant is:
(Capacitor ki capacitance vacuum ke saath 20 pF aur dielectric ke saath 90 pF hai. Dielectric constant kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: The ratio of the capacitance of a parallel plate capacitor with an insulating substance as medium between the plates

blocks.prompt:
66 The dielectric constant εᵣ of a medium has:
(Kisi medium ke dielectric constant εᵣ ki unit kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: εᵣ = C_med/C_vac do capacitances ki nisbat hai, is liye be-unit hai (Eq. 16.34).

book_ref.quote: Dividing Eq.16.33 by Eq.16.32, we get expression for dielectric constant as:

blocks.prompt:
67 The potential difference between the plates decreases on inserting a dielectric because of:
(Dielectric dalne par plates ke darmiyan potential difference kis wajah se kam hota hai?)

options.text: charge ka Earth mein leak hona

blocks.explanation: Yeh kami dielectric ke atoms ke polarization ki wajah se hai (16.5).

book_ref.quote: The reason for decrease in potential difference between the plates of the capacitor is the polarization of the atoms

blocks.prompt:
68 A dielectric is a material which:
(Dielectric kaisa maadda hai?)

options.text: jis mein bohat azad electrons hain

blocks.explanation: Dielectric insulator hai; us ke tamam electrons apne nuclei se bandhe hote hain (16.5).

book_ref.quote: It has no free electrons, i.e., all the electrons are bound to their respective positively charged nuclei.

blocks.prompt:
69 When an atom of a dielectric is placed in an electric field, its electrons are displaced slightly:
(Dielectric ka atom electric field mein rakhne par us ke electrons thora sa kis taraf khisakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Electrons nucleus ke muqable field ke ulat thora khisakte hain: polarization (16.5).

book_ref.quote: its electrons are displaced slightly relative to the nucleus in a direction opposite to the field

blocks.prompt:
70 The charges induced on the faces of a dielectric slab next to the capacitor plates are:
(Capacitor plates ke saath dielectric slab ki satah par paida hone wale charges:)
